description: Theater explores the stage from both sides of the curtain: reading or watching plays, writing a one-act play, safety and the roles of cast and crew, pantomime, and the language of the stage.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words.

references.label: Official merit badge page (scouting.org Merit Badge Hub)

requirements.title: Plays
requirements.summary: Watching or reading full-length plays and reviewing each.

requirements.title: Writing a play
requirements.summary: Writing a short one-act play with a main character, a conflict and a climax.

requirements.title: Safety and roles
requirements.summary: Theater safety and several roles, such as acting, directing, design or stage management.

requirements.title: Pantomime
requirements.summary: Miming a scenario your counselor chooses.

requirements.title: Stage terms
requirements.summary: Terms such as proscenium, stage left and right, flies and sightlines.
